blocks.x: I could have gone with Fletcher. In fact, I later went with Fletcher.

Oh yeah, I played Harvard, Yale, Dartmouth and I'll never forget I had that llama coat you saw in that bus and we got up into New Hampshire, somewhere up there, the snow was so heavy, the bus couldn't move. I was with Fletcher.
WAS THIS AFTER THE TRENT BAND BROKE UP?
DURING THE TIME WHEN TRENT WAS LAYING OFF.
No, no this was way later. This was in between Claude Hopkins and Fats.
OH YEAH. RIGHT AROUND THE TIME FLETCHER WAS REORGANIZING. AFTER THAT BAND BROKE UP WITH PAUL JONES, JOHNSON AND OTHERS, THE BAND HAD DAN WEBSTER AND JOE THOMAS, RED ALLEN WAS IN THE BAND WITH YOU.
I don't think so. I don't remember who was in the band.

IT MUST HAVE BEEN THE TIME WHEN THE BAND WAS REORGANIZED. IT WAS PROBABLY AFTER (Inaudible) PROBABLY AFTER YOU LEFT THE BAND WAS PROBABLY AFTER (Inaudible) PROBABLY AFTER YOU LEFT FLOYD AND WENT WITH FATS.

YEAH, THAT'S POSSIBLE. I'LL LOOK THAT UP NEXT TIME WE GET TOGETHER. I'LL TRANSCRIBE THESE REELS OF TAPE AND THEN I'LL FILL IN ALL THE DIFFERENT THINGS WHEN WE GET TOGETHER AGAIN. WE HAVE TO BECAUSE WE HAVE TO MAKE FIVE HOURS OUT OF THIS. WE HAVE TO EARN OUR SALARY HERE.
After we get through with this, I'd like to make another one.
